params.body:
Two fixes to the home hero, both found on staging with the real Sanity photo and text.

## Line breaks from Sanity

The hero text in Sanity is a paragraph followed by a list of services, one per line with a "•". The site printed it as one paragraph, so on a phone it read as a single block of text.

- `Content::blocks()` turns line breaks into paragraphs, and lines starting with "•", "- " or "* " into one list.
- `partials/text` renders the blocks, with small accent bullets.
- Used for the hero and story text on home, the sell-page intro and the history intro.
- A one-line text renders as before. A dash without a space ("-20%") stays text.

## Contrast

On the staging photo, which has a white facade and a light sky, the light-blue intro reached only 3.5:1 at 1024px and 4.1:1 on a phone. That is below AA, measured against the brightest 5% of the photo behind the letters.

- The intro is now white.
- The shade is 70% brand-900. That is the lightest at which all hero text reaches AAA (7:1, large text 4.5:1) at 390, 768, 1024, 1440 and 1920px, on both the staging photo and the built-in one. The weakest spot measures 7.2:1.
- From `lg` on, the shade (`.hero-shade` in `app.css`) covers only the text column: full strength until 120px before the h1's right edge, gone 380px past it. The right side of the photo stays clear. Below `lg` it is an even veil.

## Tests

- `SanityTextBlocksTest`: blocks, the dash case, and the hero markup with a list.
- Full suite: 85 tests green.
params.title: Home hero: keep Sanity line breaks, shade to AAA
